scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @daytrace/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @daytrace/site typecheck && pnpm --filter @daytrace/h5 typecheck
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:packages && tsx --tsconfig apps/api/tsconfig.json --test packages/config/src/*.test.ts packages/contracts/src/*.test.ts apps/api/src/common/*.test.ts apps/api/src/modules/content/*.test.ts tests/unit/reader/*.test.ts tests/unit/find/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build:packages && tsx --tsconfig apps/api/tsconfig.json --test tests/integration/api.integration.test.ts tests/e2e/find/*.test.ts && tsx --tsconfig tests/integration/access/tsconfig.json --test tests/integration/access/*.test.ts && pnpm test:demo
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @daytrace/api build && pnpm --filter @daytrace/site build && pnpm --filter @daytrace/h5 build
scripts.test:modules: tsx --tsconfig tests/integration/access/tsconfig.json --test tests/unit/reader/*.test.ts tests/unit/find/*.test.ts tests/e2e/find/*.test.ts tests/integration/access/*.test.ts
